provenance.note: Observed from the 2560x1440 saltbot MYTHOS reference supplied in chat; bounds are visual estimates from the clean displayed image.

intent.purpose: Reuse the reference's per-difficulty version timeline in the existing MaiDeck song-info graphic without copying its overall skin.
intent.exactness_note: Version identity, constants, and direction indicators must be exact; composition and styling should follow MaiDeck.

coverage.granularity: Major layout regions and the reusable constant-history unit; repeated micro-decoration is grouped.
notes: The reference's exact fonts and source layers are unknown.

source_images.scope_note: Use only the history strip's information hierarchy; do not reproduce saltbot branding, player identity, background artwork, or full composition.
Planned deterministic output canvas implemented by the existing song-info renderer.

composition.value: Wide game-themed information card with a player banner at top, stacked difficulty rows at left, and a jacket panel at right.
composition.note: The MaiDeck remix keeps its existing vertical song-info composition instead.

palette.value: Bright sky background, mint panels, and difficulty-coded green, orange, red, and purple bands.
palette.note: Only difficulty color semantics carry over; MaiDeck retains its dark translucent palette.

medium.value: Deterministic raster UI graphic with logos and exact typography.
medium.note: Exact text and badges favor canvas composition over generative reconstruction.

selections.instruction: Rebuild the constant timeline as a compact dark translucent MaiDeck panel: exact version logos, chronological change points, green up arrows, red down arrows, gray unchanged arrows, and one-decimal constants.
preserve: direction indicator tied to the prior recorded value
allow: increase a MaiDeck difficulty row's height
use text when a version logo is unavailable

invariants.description: Never infer or fabricate a missing historical constant.
International history must stop at the current International release; later JP-only releases must not appear.
Do not reproduce source branding or watermark text.

unknowns.reason: The upstream metadata does not contain every early-version constant for every chart.
The font cannot be established from pixels alone and is irrelevant to the MaiDeck restyle.

hard.description: Every displayed constant and version comes from normalized source data.
hard.check: Compare rendered milestones with the chart's normalized history entries.

hard.description: Direction arrows correctly compare each displayed change with its prior recorded value.
hard.check: Exercise increases, decreases, and unchanged latest values in unit tests.

hard.description: The timeline is visibly labeled International and excludes releases newer than the current International version.
hard.check: Import a fixture containing a later JP release and verify it is absent.

soft.description: The history reads left to right without crowding the existing chart facts.
soft.check: Inspect the rendered fixture at full size.

soft.description: The new panel feels native to MaiDeck's dark translucent visual system.
soft.check: Compare panel radius, opacity, typography, and spacing with adjacent MaiDeck panels.
